explicit_edge_rule: Backlinks and used-in relations derive from stored stable relationships, governed references or incorporation receipts. Similarity may propose a candidate edge but cannot create project-memory structure silently.
history_rule: For governed objects CSW history references target-domain provenance/version/Event evidence rather than restating the governed event as CSW truth.
version_rules: fragment version remains owned by CSW-01 seam
governed pinned reference pins target version/evidence
current reference re-resolves current authorized projection
saved view is query preference not result snapshot
privacy_rules: historical unavailable reference shown only if viewer may know reference exists
cross_project_rules: one fragment may be referenced by multiple authorized projects
project membership does not fork identity
governed object references may appear in multiple Story Bibles without copying truth
project annotations are separate from governed object
recovery_rule: Search/graph/story-bible projections are rebuildable from durable fragment/reference/provenance state; projections themselves are not authoritative persistence.

CSW-03: Idea Inbox maps directly to Library inbox view and project placement
CSW-05: plot structures remain evidence-classed creative material until D28 incorporation
CSW-06: continuity checks must cite evidence class and source links
CSW-09: Continue/Open/Unused/Recent surfaces consume these safe projections
CSW-10: final persistence decision must preserve target-domain reference rather than copied truth
